primaryPlanningRange.assumptions: Actual input provisionally 25–50% of reserved UTF-8 units; output 40–100% of cap including thinking. These are planning scenarios, not a measured tokenizer estimate.

primaryConservativeAllowance.method: Treat each reservation unit, including dynamic verification holdbacks, as one billed input token; all output caps consumed; no cache or off-peak discount.

recoveryAllowance.notes: Spending allowance, not raised token caps: charge a full root input allowance plus 32768 output tokens per fallback to leave room for separate Gemini thought counters. This is an estimate, not a provider hard bound. Actual requests must fit remaining root budget. Stop if actual billing exceeds a reserved spending allowance. No search, grounding, audio or retrying tools allowed.

unknownSpendPolicy: Debit the full predispatch published-rate allowance until reconciled; never treat missing ledger prices or unknown usage as zero.
